Fixed protocol of the first cycle

What not to repeat without a new hypothesis

Don't repeat these 24 model/It's packing and not retraining the same six predictors on a test that you've already looked at for random improvement. New generators need new specific assumptions; new predictors need a separate experiment and a fresh test. Current data, models, sources, parameters and reports are stored and can be analyzed without computation.

Inferencing time in JSON - batch prediction on already prepared features; the price for one address is depreciated and does not include process start, file reading and conversion HASH160 The ideal velocity multiplier in the report should not be interpreted as a measured gain of real brute force.
